concerns.description: Evidence-integrity overclaim: restrict Finn negative conclusions to literal Straylight coupling and the PostgreSQL storage surface. Preserve TIER_TRUST_MAP and CRITICAL_ACTIONS as unresolved locally-defined-classification findings; do not infer broader Finn non-drift or no-creep.

P-5 and P-13 overrestrict authorized runtime behavior. Recast around no semantic redefinition, unauthorized re-minting, or self-authorized admission while preserving authorized runtime execution of policy, emission of Straylight-defined receipts, append of Straylight-defined audit events, and persistence of the chain.

P-2 unsupported domain-model prohibition: narrow the ban to provider-, deployment-, and host-specific product concepts, semantics, and configuration; do not ban all provider-neutral storage-host, cloud, runtime, or model-provider concepts.
